name: PlayerInput
shortDescription: Keyboard, mouse and gamepads behind logical actions, mapped to players with string tags.
description: One input layer for aMAZE: Forward/Backward/Left/Right/Jump/Melee/Shoot/Dash/Pause plus menu actions, read from keyboard, mouse and up to 4 gamepads. Devices belong to string tags (P1, P2), so local co-op only needs AssignDevice. Also a small menu helper (arrows, D-pad, stick, mouse hover and click).
